name: Sobel Magnitude Distribution
algorithm: Sobel Magnitude Distribution — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes Sobel magnitude distributions for image forensic analysis following Sobel & Feldman (1968):

1. **Sobel边缘检测**: The Sobel operator computes horizontal (Gx) and vertical (Gy) gradients using 3×3 kernels. The gradient magnitude G = √(Gx² + Gy²) and direction θ = arctan(Gy/Gx) are computed at each pixel, providing a robust measure of edge strength and orientation.

2. **幅度分布分析**: The histogram of Sobel magnitude values across the image is analyzed. Natural images show specific magnitude distributions following approximately an exponential or Weibull distribution. AI-generated images may show different distributions — modified tail behavior, unusual peak structures, or distribution shape inconsistent with optical imaging.

3. **空间幅度Patterns**: The spatial distribution of Sobel magnitudes reveals the image's edge structure. In natural images, high-magnitude pixels (strong edges) form connected contours following object boundaries. AI-generated images may show: fragmented edge structures, edge magnitudes not consistent with depth-of-field expectations, or unnaturally uniform edge strength.

4. **幅度-Direction相关性**: In natural images, edge magnitude and direction are correlated through scene structure — strong edges along object boundaries have coherent directions. The method analyzes magnitude-direction correlation. AI artifacts may produce strong gradients with incoherent directions.

5. **SobelFeature评分**: Sobel magnitude features (distribution parameters, spatial patterns, magnitude-direction correlation, multi-scale behavior) are combined into a forensic score. The score measures deviation from natural image edge statistics.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： sobel magnitude distribution 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Sobel, I. & Feldman, G. (1968). A 3x3 Isotropic Gradient Operator for Image Processing. Stanford AI Project.
Gonzalez, R.C. & Woods, R.E. (2018). Digital Image Processing. 4th Edition. Pearson.
